scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run composer:all && npm run build:all && npm run install:plugins
scripts.composer:all: npm run composer:root && npm run composer:aura
scripts.install:all: npm run install:aura && npm run install:blocks
scripts.install:plugins: vendor/bin/wp plugin activate duplicate-post && vendor/bin/wp plugin activate polylang && vendor/bin/wp plugin activate seo-by-rank-math && vendor/bin/wp plugin activate contact-form-7 && vendor/bin/wp plugin activate drag-and-drop-multiple-file-upload-contact-form-7
scripts.build:all: npm run build:aura && npm run build:blocks
scripts.zip:aura: rm -rf aura.zip && npm run build:all && npm run composer:aura && cd web/app/themes && 7z a -tzip ../../../aura.zip aura -x!aura/node_modules -x!aura/resources/images -x!aura/src -x!aura/app/blocks/node_modules -x!.git -x!src -x!scripts -x!*.html && cd ../../..
